title: Austin's Secret Real Estate Talks
summary:
*   A special meeting was held solely to announce the City would immediately move into a closed-door executive session.
*   The private discussion focused on sensitive topics like potential real estate transactions (buying, selling, or leasing property), prospective gifts or donations, and related contract negotiations.
*   No public hearings or policy decisions were made during the open portion of this meeting; any final actions would be taken in a future public session.
